items.title: Walmart tries to copy a successful Costco strategy
items.summary: The move has boosted customer loyalty for Costco, and Walmart is hoping shoppers recognize how much it can benefit them.

items.title: Can Kroger Keep Its Earnings Promise With Sales This Weak?
items.summary: Kroger (KR) has cut its 2026 same-store sales outlook and kept its 2026 profit outlook. If you own the stock, the easy comfort is that earnings held. The risk sits inside that comfort. The cost savings holding up profit are the same savings management plans to spend on lower shelf prices, and the stock is down 15% over the past six months.

items.title: Costco expands DoorDash and Uber delivery as membership growth slows
items.summary: DoorDash and Uber are giving Costco a much wider digital reach at an important moment for its membership business.

items.title: 2 Reasons to Like COST (and 1 Not So Much)
items.summary: Over the past six months, Costco’s shares (currently trading at $894.40) have posted a disappointing 10.2% loss, well below the S&P 500’s 12.9% gain. This may have investors wondering how to approach the situation.

items.title: Costco’s Painful Move Shows the Cost of Relying on the Gulf, Especially as Walmart and Amazon Are Still Unaffected
items.summary: Costco nearly doubled its motor oil price on a base-oil shortage, and its bulk model is why it moved before rivals did.

items.title: Is Costco Stock Too Expensive Now?
items.summary: Some income investors may feel that Costco's dividend yield isn't high enough to justify the stock's premium price tag.

items.title: Costco Ramps Up Same-Day Delivery, Expanding Uber, DoorDash Partnerships
items.summary: Costco is expanding its fast delivery network as it works to grow sales in new ways.  Earlier this week Uber said it would expand its partnership with Costco to deliver products in 47 U.S. states, up from 17 states.  On Thursday DoorDash said it would also start delivering Costco products in the U.S. from all U.S. locations.
